name: Golden Designs Soria 3-Person Indoor Hybrid Sauna
description: Golden Designs Soria 3-Person Hybrid Sauna (PureTech™ Full Spectrum Infrared & Harvia SWS80) Discover the Golden Designs Soria Indoor Hybrid Sauna, featuring PureTech Full Spectrum Infrared Technology and a Harvia Traditional Stove. Transform it into a yoga/stretching studio by removing the benches. Crafted from reforested Canadian Hemlock, this eco-friendly sauna heats up quickly, retains heat efficiently, and uses less energy. Features 3-person capacity Near Zero EMF - EMF Under 3 mg when sitting 2 to 3 inches from the heating panels Natural Reforested Canadian Hemlock Wood Construction New Floating Bench Design 1 Himalayan Salt Bar Interior LED Control Panel with built in FM Radio and Bluetooth Connection Bluetooth and MP3 Auxiliary Connection with Built in Speakers Oversize interior chromotherapy lighting system Full Spectrum IR: Total 8 IR Emitters, 5 Carbon PureTech™ Near Zero EMF Heat Emitters (Heating Panels) and 3 Near Infrared Heat Emitters (Heating Elements) Harvia 6KW Traditional Sauna Stove with Built in Controls Bronze Privacy Tempered Glass Door Roof and Side Vent (Fresh Air Circulation) Specifications Electrical service: 240V / 30AMP (Stove & Full Spectrum). Please consult a certified electrician to install. Bronze Privacy Tempered Glass Door Roof and Side Vent (Fresh Air Circulation) Exterior Dimensions (WDH): 65″ x 57″ x 75″ Interior Dimensions (WDH): 60″ x 50″ x 70″ Sauna Weight: 450 lbs. Shipping Weight: 675 lbs. Ships in 4 boxes All Golden Designs Saunas Include a 5-Year Limited Warranty. View more details here. What are you waiting for? Order your sauna today and experience the Golden Designs difference.
